metadata.description: 42 Claude Code mods, one per lesson, ordered by how useful they are, with a course that explains how each one is built.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: delete-backup
plugins.description: Copies the files an rm is about to delete into a backup folder first, so /undo-delete can put the newest deletion back

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: a model check on each short prompt finds reusable corrections (any language); a band above the prompt saves them to CLAUDE.md on one press

plugins.name: mod-store
plugins.description: /mods: browse, search and install community Claude Code mods from a pane, with what each one can access shown before you install

plugins.name: mod-doctor
plugins.description: Mod doctor audits your installed mods with the plugin validator and flags failed checks, shared tool.call hooks and duplicate names

plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Picks the reasoning effort for each message you send, for that message only, from its words, and never switches the model

plugins.name: assumption-check
plugins.description: After a reply, lists the small guesses Claude made. Mark each Right or Wrong, and send the wrong ones back to Claude

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Claude can use a secret without seeing it: a masked box saves keys to .env and gives Claude a placeholder, every key a tool prints comes back as a placeholder, and committing .env is refused

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane beside the transcript where you ask about the session so far; answers come from a tool-less fork of the session's own transcript and nothing is written back into the main thread.

plugins.name: prompt-bouncer
plugins.description: Bounces vague prompts before Claude sees them, and suggests the project's own term

plugins.name: dictation-fixer
plugins.description: Tidies long messages that look dictated, then asks whether to send the cleaned version or the text as typed

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: ctx-handoff
plugins.description: Turns what you teach Claude into project notes, catches its usual slips, keeps the cache warm while you're away, and picks long sessions back up

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: recording-mode
plugins.description: /rec before you record: masks keys, personal details, and business figures on screen and keeps private files closed (/rec strict, /rec off, /rec config)

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Edit or Write changes a file that another chat edited in the last 30 minutes, with Proceed and Cancel

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, doing now, waiting on you, next. /where for a longer one.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Your plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage as small bars above the prompt, with the reset countdown and the session's cost.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, plus a code map of the files they touch.

plugins.name: test-fail-magnet
plugins.description: Keeps the failing tests from your last test run in a Failing tests pane, with Fix to send them to Claude and Dismiss to clear them

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: A prompt typed while Claude is working is held in a stack above the prompt instead of landing in the running turn, and sent once the turn ends. Reorder the stack, edit a row in place, send one first, remove one, flush the lot. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

plugins.name: spend-guard
plugins.description: Asks Proceed or Cancel, with a short checklist, before a command or MCP tool that costs money or publishes runs

plugins.name: heads-up
plugins.description: After a long turn, one Haiku call flags up to two things you might miss, in a band above the prompt. Off until /heads-up on

plugins.name: human-in-the-loop
plugins.description: Claude assigns you the tasks only you can do. They wait in a My tasks pane, counted under the prompt, until you answer or reject them, so nothing Claude needs from you gets lost in the chat.

plugins.name: diagram-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that pins every diagram Claude draws, keeps a live map of the work, and lets you go into boxes and change them

plugins.name: status-banner
plugins.description: One status banner above the prompt: plan usage, the session's turn, speed, cost, cache countdown with a Keep warm button and context fill, a goal and next-step summary, and a heads-up after long turns.

plugins.name: spoken-alerts
plugins.description: Speaks two alerts with Mac, OpenAI or ElevenLabs voices: when work ends, the project, the thread and what was done; when Claude asks you something, a chime, the question and the recommended option.

plugins.name: decision-tree
plugins.description: When Claude ends a reply with a question, explains the choice in a side pane and lets you explore any option, or your own, in a real forked session

plugins.name: plain-english
plugins.description: While on, rewrites each long reply in plain language with a short Next steps list, in a side pane, and leaves Claude's reply unchanged

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Colorful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies: tables, headings, code, numbers, paths and links.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A browser running directly inside claude code. Preview websites, view HTML documents, and let your agent control the built in browser.

plugins.name: today-report
plugins.description: Today's Report: totals your Claude Code tasks, the time they would have taken you, and tokens by day, week, month and year, from your session logs

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for Claude Code: tool rows that open onto their input and answer, highlighted code, diff, table, math, Mermaid and shell cards, links, folding, a usage band, a calm mode and fifteen themes. /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the prompt. Press 1, 2 or 3 in an empty prompt to draft one, 0 to dismiss.

plugins.name: repo-heatmap
plugins.description: A /heatmap pane that counts this repository's tracked files by top-level folder and kind, from git ls-files, as rows of colored bars

plugins.name: design-picker
plugins.description: When Claude asks you to choose a design style, opens a page in your browser that shows each option as a styled card, then shows the normal question

plugins.name: daily-challenge
plugins.description: One small Claude Code challenge each day in a /challenge pane, with Coach me, Done and Skip buttons and a streak

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks haiku, sonnet or opus for each subagent Claude starts without naming a model, from one small Haiku call, and never changes the main chat's model

plugins.name: narrator
plugins.description: Reads the last 240 characters of each finished reply aloud with macOS say, off by default and switched with /narrator on and /narrator off

plugins.name: time-lapse
plugins.description: Time-lapse: records your session's prompts, tool calls and turn times, and replays them as an animated HTML page

plugins.name: terminal-pet
plugins.description: A small text pet in the band above the prompt that eats the files Claude reads, with /pet on, /pet off and /pet name

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: Snake in a pane while Claude works, paused when it's done. Opt-in, so nothing opens until /snake.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: turn number, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown and context fill; notifies before the cache expires.
